hotels.title: Award-Winning Queensland Glamping Retreat with Two-Course Private Dinner & Smithy's Outback Dinner Show
hotels.description: Set on Queensland’s Mitchell Grass Plains outside Longreach, this luxury glamping retreat captures the raw beauty of the Channel Country through wide-sky views, changing light across the paddocks and near-perfect stargazing after dark. Low-slung weatherproof canvas pavilions are oriented to make the most of the landscape in every direction. Spend an evening at Smithy's Outback Dinner & Show for live entertainment and camp-oven cuisine beside the coolabah-lined Thomson River, or kayak at your own pace come morning. Indulge in gourmet breakfast food with your included hamper, then enjoy a privately cooked dinner with premium wine. Heli-flight tours to Darr River Downs Station offer an authentic working cattle property experience, while the communal firepit area is the perfect spot to share stories under a canopy of stars.

hotels.title: Outback Queensland All-Inclusive Adventure with Australian Storytelling Tours & Sunset Cruise
hotels.description: Longreach is the birthplace of Qantas, home of the Australian Stockman's Hall of Fame and the gateway to the real outback, and this fully organised coach tour in central Queensland places you right in the middle of the town's heritage heart. With included accommodation at pioneer-inspired stay The Staging Post - plus daily breakfast, lunch and dinner included - you'll be all set to savour the serenity and discover Australia's extraordinary history. Step into a courtyard filled with vintage vehicles, with the town's shops, cafes and restaurants all within easy walking distance. Pack your akubra: this adventure's filled with outback gems and extraordinary experiences. Tour the Australian Stockman's Hall of Fame and trace the history of the people who opened up the outback, walk through the origins of Australia's national airline at the Qantas Founders Museum and board the Cobb & Co Stagecoach for a ride on the original Longreach-Windorah mail route. Come evening, Starlight's Cruise takes you out on the Thomson River as the sun goes down, followed by a two-course dinner around the campfire, bush poetry and the Starlight's Spectacular Sound & Light Show on the riverbank.
